_readme: Temporary Qwen lane proxy (:8030 -> local vLLM :8100). Single-model lane: regular requests preserve the caller's thinking kwargs; response_format requests are rewritten with BOTH enable_thinking=false and thinking=false so whichever key the deployed chat template reads gets the no-think boundary seeded. No sampling enforcement (Temperature/TopP null). Multimodal and LoopGuard disabled. For temp/verification use; not installed as a systemd unit.
